text:
Portfolio Management Services | Longwall Family Office
Many would simply refer to a family office as a private wealth management advisory firm that serves high-net-worth individuals and their families. 
But family offices are different from traditional wealth management firms since they usually look to provide a holistic solution to managing the financial and investment needs of an affluent family or individual. For example, in addition to investment management, family offices offer estate planning, charitable giving, investment education, insurance, and tax advice. In various forms and with various degrees of emphasis, Longwall Family Office also offers these services. But it is not just a bundle of services that defines the family office for the Longwall Partners. There is also an attitude, a style of operation, and a culture that is brought to bear on the various offerings of the Firm. 
At Longwall, we think that a family investment office should be a place where capital is managed with the utmost of care, professionalism, and competency, and where there is as much as practically possible a very close alignment of interests. To a family client at Longwall, it should not feel as if the Firm is an outside service provider dealing with their investments. Rather, it should feel as if client families are inside the office, working with and conversing with their own partners and experts, not at arms’ length but in an immediate and familiar fashion. The dialogues should be candid. The understanding of the family’s needs and particularities should be detailed and deep. There should be a great deal of back and forth. If a client wants to see the development of a particular investment plan or specific opportunity, as the due diligence is coming along, then that is what they should get. In this way, the investment recommendations and the choices that are ultimately made will be significantly stronger, and better understood. 
Finally, a word or two on “education” and on solid “alignment” within a family office setting. Clients of the Longwall Family Office are encouraged to learn as much as they can about the investment universe and about best practices in investing and portfolio management. The Longwall Partners have the skills and backgrounds to help on this score, and what is just as important, they greatly enjoy the educational aspects of the work they do, and enjoy the conversations about markets, risks, and opportunities. As for alignment, the Principals of the Firm like to invest alongside client capital where they can, to get as much alignment as can be achieved. While some people see such instances of co-investment as setting up potential conflicts of interest (and we can see how that could be so characterized) we see it quite differently and believe that it is ideal when a Longwall Partner is able to invest in the same holdings or opportunities as family clients. We, therefore, live with similar risks and rewards. From the perspective of the Longwall Family Office, these aspects of a family office offering are very good things, and we hope you might see the above features in a similar light.

We may share non-public personal information with non-affiliated third parties (such as administrators, brokers, custodians, regulators, credit agencies, other financial institutions) as necessary for us to provide agreed-upon services to you, consistent with applicable law, including but not limited to: processing transactions; general account maintenance; responding to regulators or legal investigations; and credit reporting.

Marketing Purposes

LIP does not disclose, and does not intend to disclose, personal information with non-affiliated third parties to offer you services. Certain laws may give us the right to share your personal information with financial institutions where you are a customer and where LIP or the client has a formal agreement with the financial institution. We will only share information for purposes of servicing your accounts, not for marketing purposes.

Authorized Users

Your non-public personal information may be disclosed to you and persons that we believe to be your authorized agent\[s\] or representative\[s\].

Information About Former Clients

LIP does not disclose and does not intend to disclose, non-public personal information to non-affiliated third parties with respect to persons who are no longer our Clients.

## Changes to our Privacy Policy

We will send you a copy of this Policy annually for as long as you maintain an ongoing relationship with us.

Periodically we may revise this Policy and will provide you with a revised Policy if the changes materially alter the previous Privacy Policy. We will not, however, revise our Privacy Policy to permit the sharing of non-public personal information other than as described in this notice unless we first notify you and provide you with an opportunity to prevent the information sharing.

## Any Questions?

You may ask questions or voice any concerns, as well as obtain a copy of our current Privacy Policy by contacting us at (203) 209-2785.

# CM Wealth | Your Family Office

## CM Wealth is your family office, helping you invest, manage, and transfer wealth in a legacy of purpose

![Architectural pillars representing the institutional strength and stability of CM Wealth, a multi-family office serving the Cleveland, Ohio area from its office in nearby Beachwood..](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/641f02a5dcca762202019580/c0462cee-6e48-486c-90d4-17d1e49c987f/Pillars_CM+Wealth.png)

## **We deliver institutional strength with individual care.**

Founded in 1983 as a single-family office, we’ve grown to an employee-owned firm of 25 professionals serving 30+ families through financial and lifestyle services with customization and care. We manage more than $2 billion in assets, carrying out investment, wealth management, and philanthropic strategies that aim to help clients build generational prosperity and purpose.

![Coordinated sailboats representing a unified team approach to multi-generational wealth management and family office oversight within CM Wealth, a multi-family office in Ohio..](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/641f02a5dcca762202019580/a9b9a2ef-2a2f-4935-b5a0-55543846562e/Boats.png)

## **Allow us to unify your team and deliver peace of mind.**

Our multi-family office team gets to know you and customizes our services to your preferences and values. As your family office, we unify everyone on your team—relatives, advisors, accountants, attorneys, and managers—toward a shared goal.

![Pyramid visual representing the platform of values and financial freedom provided by CM Wealth’s philanthropy and trust administration services.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/641f02a5dcca762202019580/b19c4ac9-fe67-4cc7-8748-ec1a835fcd26/Pyramid_CM+Wealth.png)

## **Preserve your legacy. Move forward with clarity. Free your family from the day-to-day and enjoy the life you’ve built.**

Your wealth is a platform for values that outlast you. We translate those values into enduring structures and practical freedom, so you can live your legacy, not manage it.

**Legacy** is at the core of our partnership. We help you build and preserve your family values, wealth, and a name that endures across generations.

**Philanthropy** is a popular expression of legacy. For clients who wish, we structure giving for maximum impact—donor-advised funds, mission-aligned investments, and stewarded grantmaking that reflect your values.

**Freedom** allows you focus to live out your legacy. Consolidate administration and advisory coordination—bill pay, trust administration, advisor management, and family governance—and regain time and choice.

## **Enjoy a Boutique Approach From a Multi-Family Office**

As a multi-family office, we act as the central engine for your family’s financial life. Our team of 25 professionals provides a dedicated, high-touch alternative to institutional banks—delivering integrated services in wealth transfer, estate planning, investment strategy, tax prep, bill pay, financial education, and philanthropy.

# Family Office & Wealth Management Services | CM Wealth — CM Wealth | Your Family Office

## **Wealth and Lifestyle Services for Multi-Gen Families**

Gain a partner who unifies family and service providers. Receive private investment opportunities. Acquire concierge services that sustain your family’s quality of life.

### Wealth

*   Create a financial roadmap where your assets are managed in service to your vision and external accounts are integrated under one master plan.
    
*   Prepare for the eventual sale of your business and have a strategy set to minimize the tax effects on your liquidity.
    
*   Align your tax preparation with a strategic, year-round perspective that coordinates with your investments, entities, estate planning, and cash-flow preferences.
    
*   Access exclusive assets vetted by our network of industry and legal experts as part of our private equity program.
    
*   Receive a complete review of your estate planning documents as well as guidance tailored to your timelines and aspirations.
    

### Lifestyle

*   Lead your family into unity and peace. Create a shared sense of purpose around philanthropy, passion projects, and new business ventures.
    
*   Ease your mind as our team advocates for you in consumer matters and assists you with logistics during family emergencies.
    
*   Receive reviews and recommendations on all insurance (life, property and casualty, liability, and health) through our professional partnerships.
    
*   Delegate personal financial complexities. Our CFO service efficiently manages bill payments, expense tracking, and financial administration to ensure seamless operation and free your time.
    
*   Establish a family vision statement, implement a governance structure, and benefit from concierge services that educate your loved ones on financial acumen and cybersecurity.
    

## **Built for Complexity and Designed for You**

Your family and financial life are unique—your strategy should be too. We replace rigid models with a flexible framework, so you can adapt to your objectives, not your firm’s constraints.

### **Wealth Management Advisory**

*   Discretionary investment advisory portfolio management services
*   Financial and estate planning and consulting
*   Tax planning, preparation, and compliance
*   Insurance and risk management
*   Lifestyle and liquidity management
*   Family governance, education, and philanthropy

**Total Financial Oversight and Execution**

*   Standalone investment advisory services (AUM or retainer-based)

*   Business consulting

Lennertz & Co. Ihr Multi Family Office
Lennertz & Co. is an owner-managed family office with a clear focus on the further development and value growth of its clients’ assets.
To this end, our team of more than 30 employees conducts a detailed and ongoing review of the entire family situation, taking into account the legal and tax-related framework conditions.
Our investment recommendations are fully aligned with the clients’ personal preferences. Given our complete independence, the clients are able to fully benefit from our unbiased assessment of global investment opportunities, their selection and their discreet implementation.
As an entrepreneurial family office, we appreciate our clients’ need for quick, profound and safe decisions. Lennertz & Co. has a number of licenses from the German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin, Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht) and is therefore subject to numerous quality and regulatory requirements of both BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank.

Entrepreneurial Investing
Since the foundation of Lennertz & Co., entrepreneurial investing has been at the heart of our investment philosophy, and the selection of the best investment opportunities in the field of private equity and venture capital (PE/VC) has been one of our focal points. Over the years, this has given rise to our own alternative investment platform, today's Lennertz & Co. Capital GmbH. Its offering includes a wide range of investment opportunities in private markets, managed accounts, and advanced reporting.
Access to the top addresses in the private equity and venture capital industry in Europe and especially in the U.S. is crucial. Family Office - Boston MFO
Our family office clients are at the centre of a global community of highly qualified attentive professionals. Supported by expert advisors with key market specialties, and using a single point of contact with a dedicated Client Relationship Manager, we give you the confidence to make informed and incisive decisions as guardians of your family wealth.
We do this because we, too, are entrepreneurs. We embrace change and innovation, and simplify financial complexity with services that extend beyond asset management to encompass an entire way of life.
Working With Boston Multi-Family Office
Every family office client is unique. Direct interaction with our Chief Executive and the senior management team ensures that our multi-family office services meets your specific ambitions, whilst a dedicated Client Relationship Manager is appointed to provide a single point of contact for our future together.
As an independent business, we offer truly impartial services to our clients. Our heritage as a successful family office has afforded us a profound understanding of the challenges and opportunities inherent in managing wealth over multiple generations.
Family Governance & Liaison Services
We work with you and, where applicable, your existing family office and advisers, to deliver an integrated service. 
We utilise the full range of skills and services at our disposal, resulting in optimum performance in every aspect of the development and maintenance of family governance.
Fiduciary Services
With a diverse team and a trusted international adviser network, we bring years of experience and expertise on all aspects of fiduciary matters. We deal with the administration and management of investment vehicles such as trusts, foundations and companies, as well as the management entities holding luxury assets such as yachts, aircraft, cars and art. We source tax and legal advice and representation, assuring you of a confidential, flexible and rigorous solution to the challenge of protecting and preserving family wealth.
We have significant experience in establishing companies to hold luxury assets such as yachts and aircraft. In these cases, companies are used primarily for limitation of liability, VAT compliance, and in some cases monetisation or commercialisation of the asset.
Consolidated Reporting
We provide consolidated reporting to give you a single point of control for the organisation of your affairs.
Financial And Insurance Planning
We undertake reviews of your existing cover and commission new policies from underwriters to ensure that family assets are efficiently covered and that contingency financial arrangements are in place.
Estate Planning
Comprehensive estate planning is vital to make sure that the family estate is passed down to the family members intact and that family wealth is preserved for future generations. We will make sure that the most appropriate structures are in place and act as executors and administrators if required.
Personal Cash Flow Management
Whatever assistance is required, from setting up bank accounts, managing standing orders and other regular transfers, to providing information on monthly budget and expenses, our financial experts are on hand to ensure everything runs smoothly.
Family Constitutions and Policies
The management and distribution of family commercial wealth can be a sensitive undertaking which requires confidence, professionalism, and care. Our independent family constitutions and policies can ensure the following items are taken care of, leaving you and your family to continue on a shared vision for continued success:
The aims and objectives of the business;
The areas of responsibility of different family members;
Procedures for employment of non-family members;
Share dividends, voting control, power structure;
Succession planning; and
Meetings and dispute resolution process.
Risk Management
This can be a complex area depending on the size of the family, the structure of the family business, and the roles different family members may play.
Our comprehensive services cover fact-finding, troubleshooting, facilitation, and assistance with amendments to the family constitution and other business documents.
Property And Land Management
We offer comprehensive property and land management services with representation at every stage of the process including sourcing and acquisition, advising on and implementing the best ownership structure, identifying and managing appropriate servicing and maintenance contractors, optimising utilisation, and leveraging of the asset as well as best practice on sale or disposal.
Yacht And Aircraft Registration
We are experts in establishing and managing yacht ownership structures across multiple jurisdictions and offer full fiduciary and financial services for the ownership structure, including administration and accountancy services, VAT registration and administration, arranging importation, and registration services as required.

Direct interaction with our Chief Executive and the senior management team ensures that our multi-family office services meets your specific ambitions, whilst a dedicated Client Relationship Manager is appointed to provide a single point of contact for our future together.

As an independent business, we offer truly impartial services to our clients. Our heritage as a successful family office has afforded us a profound understanding of the challenges and opportunities inherent in managing wealth over multiple generations.

## Family Governance & Liaison Services

We work with you and, where applicable, your existing family office and advisers, to deliver an integrated service.

We utilise the full range of skills and services at our disposal, resulting in optimum performance in every aspect of the development and maintenance of family governance.

## Fiduciary Services

With a diverse team and a trusted international adviser network, we bring years of experience and expertise on all aspects of fiduciary matters. We deal with the administration and management of investment vehicles such as trusts, foundations and companies, as well as the management entities holding luxury assets such as yachts, aircraft, cars and art. We source tax and legal advice and representation, assuring you of a confidential, flexible and rigorous solution to the challenge of protecting and preserving family wealth.

We have significant experience in establishing companies to hold luxury assets such as yachts and aircraft. In these cases, companies are used primarily for limitation of liability, VAT compliance, and in some cases monetisation or commercialisation of the asset.

## Consolidated Reporting

We provide consolidated reporting to give you a single point of control for the organisation of your affairs.

## Financial And Insurance Planning

We undertake reviews of your existing cover and commission new policies from underwriters to ensure that family assets are efficiently covered and that contingency financial arrangements are in place.

## Estate Planning

Comprehensive estate planning is vital to make sure that the family estate is passed down to the family members intact and that family wealth is preserved for future generations. We will make sure that the most appropriate structures are in place and act as executors and administrators if required.

## Personal Cash Flow Management

Whatever assistance is required, from setting up bank accounts, managing standing orders and other regular transfers, to providing information on monthly budget and expenses, our financial experts are on hand to ensure everything runs smoothly.

## Family Constitutions and Policies

The management and distribution of family commercial wealth can be a sensitive undertaking which requires confidence, professionalism, and care. Our independent family constitutions and policies can ensure the following items are taken care of, leaving you and your family to continue on a shared vision for continued success:

*   The aims and objectives of the business;
*   The areas of responsibility of different family members;
*   Procedures for employment of non-family members;
*   Share dividends, voting control, power structure;
*   Succession planning; and
*   Meetings and dispute resolution process.

## Risk Management

This can be a complex area depending on the size of the family, the structure of the family business, and the roles different family members may play.

Our comprehensive services cover fact-finding, troubleshooting, facilitation, and assistance with amendments to the family constitution and other business documents.

## Property And Land Management

We offer comprehensive property and land management services with representation at every stage of the process including sourcing and acquisition, advising on and implementing the best ownership structure, identifying and managing appropriate servicing and maintenance contractors, optimising utilisation, and leveraging of the asset as well as best practice on sale or disposal.

## Yacht And Aircraft Registration

We are experts in establishing and managing yacht ownership structures across multiple jurisdictions and offer full fiduciary and financial services for the ownership structure, including administration and accountancy services, VAT registration and administration, arranging importation, and registration services as required.

# Family Office Services — The O'Donnell Group

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67c73bfcb468854016375e93/2e8c4171-5292-40ff-a50e-d1f3c0345895/unsplash-image-T7K4aEPoGGk.jpg)

## Office support without the office overhead.

Most advisors manage portfolios. We act as your family’s **private office**, overseeing investments and day-to-day financial administration in coordination with your CPA, attorney, and other advisors—ensuring your family’s financial life is **handled**, **organized**, and **intentional**.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67c73bfcb468854016375e93/c3a39f8c-8e64-4588-a804-ad05ff2b36bb/sand-wave-nature-textured-background-wellness-concept.jpg)

## Families we serve

Our private office is built for families around **$10M and up**, and for families who are clearly growing into that level of complexity.

### Established complexity  
**(typically $10M+)**

Families whose complexity is already real, and who want to avoid the expensive consequences of missed details.

*   Multiple income sources and entities.
    
*   Tax return with 20 to 60 K-1s and 1099s.
    
*   Private investments with capital calls and commitments.
    
*   Numerous assets and liabilities.
    
*   Consolidated reporting and clean financial statements.
    

### Growing into complexity  
**(approaching $10M)**

Families on a clear trajectory who want a system in place before things become chaotic.

*   Anticipating a business exit, liquidity event, or major income shift.
    
*   A growing real estate portfolio with multiple properties.
    
*   Starting private investing and alternative allocations.
    
*   Starting estate planning, trusts, gifting.
    
*   Multiple advisors with no true quarterback.
    

## How it works

We build a **robust infrastructure** early, keep the moving parts **coordinated**, and stay **accountable** for the details.

We’re the team that gets copied on financial communications: when we’re in the loop, deadlines are kept tight, details are tracked, and **nothing falls through the cracks**.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67c73bfcb468854016375e93/c3a39f8c-8e64-4588-a804-ad05ff2b36bb/sand-wave-nature-textured-background-wellness-concept.jpg)

## What we handle

Investment management is only part of a family’s financial life. We combine planning and portfolio management with private office support to keep your finances organized, payments handled, and your advisors aligned.

### Private office support

*   Bill pay and recurring payment management
    
*   Quarterly tax payments and tax coordination
    
*   K-1 and 1099 collection and organization
    
*   Investment tracking, capital calls, commitments
    
*   Consolidated reporting and financial statements
    
*   Coordination with your CPA, attorney, lenders, and other advisors
    
*   Insurance and liability planning across homes and entities
    

### Planning and investments

*   Full financial planning and decision support
    
*   Portfolio design and investment management
    
*   Tax-aware investment planning
    
*   Liquidity events and concentrated position strategy
    

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67c73bfcb468854016375e93/fc3030c0-5219-4390-9b84-d0bb51ee22f7/modern-geometrical-wallpaper-with-white-hexagons.jpg)

## Ready to get started?

# SSA Wealth Advisors | Index

## SSA Wealth Advisors (SSA Swiss Advisors AG) provides both Multi-Family Office and Investment Advisory & Discretionary Management Services

We combine the advantages of an independent investment advisor with the stability of being backed by Santander Group, one of the world’s top financial institutions.

As an independent investment advisor, we are registered and licensed in Switzerland by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (“FINMA”), as well as with the U.S Securities and Exchange Comission (“SEC”) under the U.S. Investment Adviser Act of 1940 (“Advisers Act”). Furthermore, the company is member of the AOOS (“Swiss supervisory organization for asset managers”).

This dual registration and operational setup allow us to support high-net-worth individuals with our investment services in an increasingly complex global environment while meeting the specific needs of U.S. and non-U.S. clients.

## Multi-Family Office Services

Our clients’ personal and professional situation may require operating with multiple banks. This diversification includes investing in different types of assets (financial and non-financial) across several jurisdictions, and making use of sophisticated estate planning tools to preserve their wealth for future generations.

There is an increased demand on our clients’ time, knowledge, and resources for obtaining a clear and up-to-date view of their assets, controlling exposure to different types of risk, evaluating the investment proposals of each institution, and analyzing the impact of legal changes on their wealth structure.

The dedicated and experienced multidisciplinary team at SSA Wealth Advisors offers solutions tailored to support and address all the above-mentioned requirements.

## Investment Advisory & Discretionary Management Services

Our proven investment concept combines the philosophy of traditional Swiss private banking with a clear focus on investment performance. This translates into a truly personalized service that prioritizes capital preservation and sustainable growth over the long-term.

To respond to our client’s needs, we offer both bespoke investment solutions and traditional discretionary portfolio management services.

text:
Family Office | Aspiriant Wealth Management
A multi-generational affair
Anne and Rob started working with Aspiriant’s Exclusive Family Office team as Rob was getting ready to retire from a large public company after a long career as a senior executive. Though the family had accumulated an estate worth over $100 million, 70% of their wealth was concentrated in one stock and they had never carved out time to create a meaningful estate plan and they had yet to execute on charitable giving goals that were very important to them. On top of it all, they also had concerns around how their wealth would impact future generations.
First, our Exclusive Family Office team worked with Anne and Rob to put a long-term wealth plan in place to quantify the amount they could comfortably earmark for family and charity. Next, we developed a globally diversified portfolio in accordance with the couple’s long-term goals and values. Then, we turned our attention to creating an estate plan to support Rob and Anne’s goals of transferring assets to future generations and philanthropic planning.
While Rob and Anne were intellectually prepared to implement tax efficient estate planning strategies, it took some time for them to become emotionally comfortable with the idea of transferring the wealth they had worked so hard to accumulate.
In response, we started the estate planning process simply and only grew to sophisticated strategies over time. We encouraged the couple to make annual exclusion gifts to their children and grandchildren, without touching their lifetime gift-tax exemption. Next, we helped incorporate more powerful tools for tax savings into the couple’s strategy, including Grantor Retained Annuity Trusts, a Family Limited Partnership and a sale to a Defective Grantor Trust. Finally, to accomplish their philanthropic goals we established a Donor Advised Fund and contributed some of the concentrated stock Rob had accumulated to optimize the tax savings associated with the significant gift.
With their comprehensive wealth plan in place, Anne and Rob were eager to bring their adult children into the conversation. While they knew the time was right to bring the kids into the fold, they found it difficult to convey the essence of the legacy they wanted to create and so they turned to Aspiriant to help facilitate these important discussions. Our initial meeting with the children evolved into an ongoing relationship with multiple members of the next generation. In addition to discussing the level of family wealth during our meetings, we focus on the purpose of the wealth, the importance around being a responsible steward of the wealth, the “why” behind the various strategies that have been implemented and how the wealth can be used as a tool for positive impact during their lives.
Developing a relationship with the extended family was the cherry on top of a successful partnership between Aspiriant and Anne and Rob. Knowing that an integrated, well thought out plan that aligned with their goals and values had been put in place, we hope Anne and Rob felt a great sense of gratitude and relief. The work they had wanted to do for years was now being tended to on an ongoing basis and we believe a weight had been lifted.
Important Disclaimer: This case study is presented as a hypothetical scenario and is intended for illustrative purposes only. It does not represent a specific client’s experience, but rather is meant to provide an example of Aspiriant’s process and methodology. An individual’s experience may vary based on his or her individual circumstances. There can be no assurance that similar results would be achieved in comparable situations. No portion of this case study is to be interpreted as a testimonial or endorsement of Aspiriant, and there is no way to ascertain whether a specific client would have been satisfied with their results.

# HB Wealth - Wealth Management Firm

## Expert Advice. Exceptional Care. Enduring Peace of Mind.™

Since our founding in 1989, HB Wealth has been committed to a fee-only fiduciary approach, which means we put our clients’ interests first. We sit on your side of the table, offering transparent, comprehensive advice tailored to your goals, your family, and your future.

## [The HB Wealth Difference](https://hbwealth.com/about-us/the-hb-wealth-difference/ "The HB Wealth Difference")

We believe a distinct combination of five pillars sets us apart from other wealth management firms.

### Wealth Advisory Services

Integrated financial planning and advice designed to help you protect, grow, and manage your wealth.

### Investment Management

Personalized portfolios built to target risk adjusted returns aligned with your goals.

### Family Office Services

A comprehensive range of services tailored to help select families manage wealth across generations.

### Service Levels & Costs

A transparent, fee-only cost structure with three levels of service to align with your needs.

## [Understanding Our Wealth Planning Process](https://hbwealth.com/insights-and-news/helpful-resources/understanding-family-offices/ "Understanding Our Wealth Planning Process")

At HB Wealth, every service we provide is grounded in a disciplined, client-centered approach to wealth planning.

### Reviewing Your Financial Landscape

We take a comprehensive view of your financial life across investments, tax planning, estate considerations, risk management, and long-term priorities to provide strategic clarity and a forward-looking wealth plan.

### Designing and Implementing Your Strategy

We integrate comprehensive financial planning with disciplined investment management to help grow and protect your wealth while aligning an implementation roadmap to your objectives.

### Proactive Oversight and Ongoing Guidance

Through ongoing monitoring, regular reviews, and coordinated guidance, we adapt your plan as life and markets evolve, with added organization and oversight for more complex financial lives.

## In-source?  
Out-Source?

Wealthy families face a tough choice when managing their investments  

Do you In-source and have the most control and personalization, but incur the cost and hassle of building your own team?

Or do you fully outsource, but lose control and customization?

## A Third Option: Co-Sourcing

#### Collaborating to build customized partnerships

Greycourt’s co-sourcing model offers ultra-high-net-worth families an alternative to traditional in-sourcing or outsourcing.

We collaboratively design customized engagements - providing the personalization and service of an in-house team, with the scale and expertise of an established institution.

Families gain access to seasoned investment professionals, a network of peers with similar needs, and a firm that never sells products—only advice.

With deep alignment between clients and Greycourt’s owner-employees, co-sourcing ensures control, customization, and continuity without the operational burden or cost of an in-house team.

## Our Expertise

We work with clients to design a customized engagement that may include the following:

![](https://www.greycourt.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/savannah-wakefield-JuGit9k28xw-unsplash-scaled.jpg)

### Strategic Portfolio Design

We craft a customized portfolio design incorporating the best of academic theory and practical market expertise. 

Each design is tailored to a client’s distinct needs, and in alignment with estate and tax planning objectives. 

All this is delivered through our independent, open-architecture model and collaborative partnership model.

![](https://www.greycourt.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/towfiqu-barbhuiya-nApaSgkzaxg-unsplash-scaled.jpg)

### Manager Research

Our manager research is never a “me-too” exercise. Our dedicated team of seasoned investors—not consultants—conducts rigorous, transparent due diligence designed to uncover high-conviction, after-tax opportunities.

We don’t maintain long lists of “approved” options; instead, we concentrate on a select set of high-conviction ideas that we believe are truly actionable for our clients.

Our disciplined, transparent process focuses us on identifying managers we believe are capable of generating sustainable alpha, while keeping our clients’ unique tax and planning considerations at the forefront.

![](https://www.greycourt.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/buddy-an-rkPmQEIJyv4-unsplash.jpg)

### Comprehensive Reporting

Thoughtful investment decision making for a family begins by getting all of your family's assets in a single report that shows historical and current performance, as well as comparison vs. relative benchmarks.

We have extensive expertise in:

*   Enterprise-wide reporting on public and private investments
*   Rigorous benchmarking, risk analysis, and private market pacing
*   Accessible and engaging educational programming for family members

![](https://www.greycourt.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/hal-gatewood-tZc3vjPCk-Q-unsplash-scaled.jpg)

### Operations Support

Greycourt’s client service team provides hands-on operational support designed to ease the administrative burden of managing substantial family wealth. From custody and trade execution to private investment logistics and comprehensive reporting, our services are tailored to each family’s needs.

We streamline processes like subscription document review, wire verification, and capital call tracking, while also aggregating performance data across asset types.

Our professionals coordinate directly with family office teams, tax advisors, and legal counsel—ensuring execution and clarity across every aspect of the investment lifecycle.

## Sign up for our newsletter

We publish 2 snapshots each month with markets and economic data and white papers on relevant topics

![](https://www.greycourt.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GC_logo_Darkcopper_web_large.png)

Professional partners and advisors

## **Comprehensive and coordinated financial advisory services**

Managing significant wealth is complex and no two situations are alike. We provide fiduciary [wealth management services](https://www.fiduciarytrust.com/our-services/index) that bring clarity across investments, planning and your long-term priorities, so every decision works together to help achieve the best outcome for your wealth. The result is better alignment, greater tax efficiency and more informed decisions across your entire financial life.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/p8ehx4mqyz/original/FTIWealthplanningservicesicon.png)

### Wealth planning & tax strategy

Gain a comprehensive wealth plan that integrates tax planning, cash flow and retirement strategies and legacy goals. Identify opportunities to help improve after-tax outcomes and support long-term financial objectives.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/yj3lsqebxf/original/pie_chart_icon.png)

### Investment management

Your portfolio is built to do more than perform. Our investment management strategies are designed to support your broader financial plan, balancing growth, risk and long-term wealth preservation.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/ddclne2e15/original/checklist_icon.png)

### Trust & estate services

Help ensure your assets go where you intend and your legacy endures, with thoughtfully designed trust and estate planning that supports smooth wealth transfer across generations.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/hbv4e7cz90/original/family_icon.png)

### Family office services

Simplify complexity and reclaim your time with a coordinated approach to handle financial, administrative and strategic wealth planning needs so you can focus on what matters most.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/okdsx6tssg/original/hand_heart_icon.png)

### Services for nonprofits

Help strengthen your organization's ability to deliver on its mission with an investment strategy and governance structure designed to support current needs while making a long-term impact.

![Tile Icon](https://franklintempletonprod.widen.net/content/yldxsyn9hu/original/badge-icon.png)

### Custody services

Keep your assets secure, organized and fully accounted for through clear reporting and visibility that keeps you informed and in control.

## Our approach: A unified strategy for your wealth

Effective wealth management requires coordination. We begin with a detailed understanding of your financial picture—your assets, obligations and long-term priorities. From there, we design a coordinated strategy that integrates investing, tax planning and estate considerations. As markets shift and your life evolves, your plan adapts, helping you reduce risk, improve tax efficiency and preserve wealth over time.

[Learn more](https://www.fiduciarytrust.com/clients-we-serve/working-with-us) about what it's like working with us.

Family Office & Wealth Services
We help our clients align their investments with the purpose of their wealth.
STRATEGIC ASSET ALLOCATION
We believe the most important starting point for the long-term management of wealth is to understand its purpose in human terms and how that translates into an investment strategy. 
We spend time with clients to understand their overall objectives in both financial and non-financial terms. We encourage clients to think about how their assets could meet the purpose of their wealth to:
Protect
To meet expenditure
Grow
For the long term
Enjoy
Properties and other assets
INVESTMENT COMMITTEE
Investment strategy recommendations are guided by our investment committee. 
This forum benefits from the perspectives and significant experience of the three investment teams across our international alliance as well as input from external research analysts.
INVESTMENT SELECTION
When looking for investment solutions we seek strategies where there is a clear philosophy and process, which has been consistently applied over time, and which we believe will deliver a repeatable investment return. Alongside this we require a clear alignment of interest between the manager and investors. We look for managers where the strategy is conducted within an operational framework which is robust and fit for purpose.
“Wren’s personal and friendly approach, their professional and meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive knowledge of the vast subject of investments is highly appreciated by us. Wren certainly inspires confidence and trust in their clients.”
PRIVATE CLIENT
SUSTAINABLE & IMPACT INVESTMENT
We write Investment Policy Statements that set out a client's approach to sustainable and impact investing. 
We advise across the impact spectrum of capital, in liquid and illiquid assets, using both specialist and multi-asset managers. We have developed our own in-house impact and engagement assessment and reporting tools. This allows us to independently assess managers and their investments so that we are able to support and challenge their investment and impact theses when necessary.
PRIVATE ASSETS
We have substantial private equity expertise and resources.
We advise clients on building, monitoring and reporting on bespoke private equity programmes. We have a team based in London, Madrid and the US dedicated to the analysis and selection of private equity opportunities. We also have the knowledge and experience to help clients with direct private investments.
CONSOLIDATED REPORTING
We have partnered with Addepar, a leading consolidated reporting tool, which allows us to provide a total balance sheet overview for families, available online and on mobile devices, as well as detailed performance reporting. We produce bespoke reporting for clients, which can range from equity monitors with daily pricing, to monthly dashboards, private equity reporting and performance contribution.

Family Office Wealth Management Services
Family Office: Aligning Generational Goals. Managing the Day-to-Day.
Enjoy the benefits of a family office without the cost and effort of maintaining one.
Family Office Q+A with Andrew Cooper 
The Family Office Paradox
Alone among many. While the success of your family office confers tremendous opportunities, it also brings complexity. Families of means often juggle multiple professionals to manage their investments, taxes, estate planning, charitable giving, household logistics, and more. Still, no matter how many professionals they hire, the complexities of a family office can make them feel overwhelmed and unsupported.
If the family is supervising a patchwork of disparate professionals, the lack of specialized integration can lead to suboptimal planning and unnecessary stress. That is where the family office advisors at Cerity Partners can help.
The Solution: Comprehensive Family Office Services
Support beyond finances. Cerity Partners Family Office provides a comprehensive suite of services that frees families to focus on what matters most. Our coordinated team of family office advisors is dedicated to preserving, growing, and protecting prosperity. We also serve as the family’s allies and advocates. Whether it’s creating an advanced giving strategy, preparing the next generation to be responsible stewards, optimizing the sale of a business, keeping family meetings productive, or simply saving them time, Cerity Partners’ family office advisors listen attentively and offer sophisticated solutions.
Cerity Partners Family Office can deliver the tools, infrastructure, and specialized knowledge that help the family manage life events and realize critical opportunities.
The Family Office Experience: A Customized Approach
Families receive the full breadth and depth of Cerity Partners through highly personalized family office wealth management services from a dedicated team. The family office is customized in various ways, including a family charitable fund, a family LLC investment vehicle, and a family office email address that reaches the entire team and can be used to facilitate communication with other professionals.
Cerity Partners Family Office clients can expect:
Thought Leadership
Our firm's experienced family office advisors and technical specialists provide timely insights on the most opportunistic and challenging financial topics of the moment.
Exceptional Talent
We attract and retain talented professionals in the wealth management industry. Advisors join Cerity Partners because they passionately believe in our approach.
Stewardship
We educate our clients on relevant wealth management issues and solutions, providing full transparency on all terms, risks, and expected outcomes.
We serve as the central hub of your Family Office, connecting you seamlessly with all of your professional services.

Great service is more than meeting expectations. It’s about redefining what’s possible—delivering results and creating an experience that stands above the rest."
Justyn Volesko, Partner & Co-Head of Family Office
The Four Pillars of Cerity Partners Family Office
Keeping the family’s financial house in order begins with bringing everything under one roof.
1
Advanced holistic planning
A truly holistic wealth plan addresses every aspect of your family’s financial well-being and long-term vision. Our services include:
Legacy planning
Income tax strategies
Advanced estate planning
Trust and fiduciary oversight
Asset protection and risk management
Life and business event planning
Philanthropy
Family governance and next-generation education
Transparent, customized reporting
By tailoring every detail to your family’s unique circumstances, we help safeguard your future and preserve your legacy for generations to come.
3
Trusted guidance and peace of mind
Our dedicated team of seasoned family office professionals provides tailored advice and proactive communication to address your family’s unique needs. With 24/7 access to trusted advisors, we simplify complex financial and lifestyle matters, offering a seamless experience for your family.
Our approach includes:
Safeguarding wealth, privacy, and legacy
Anticipating challenges and providing solutions
Continuously adapting to your evolving goals
With us as your partner, you gain the confidence of knowing that every detail is handled with precision, so your family can focus on what matters most.
2
Access to sophisticated investments
We design and manage diversified, goal-centered portfolios tailored to your family’s objectives. With access to a broad range of assets and strategies, including exclusive opportunities, we help maximize potential returns.
Our size and scale enable us to:
Secure lower fees
Gain exclusive access to unique opportunities
Negotiate seed economics in select cases
Through careful monitoring, performance benchmarking, and transparent reporting, we deliver market insights and investment solutions that go beyond traditional options—providing the tools your family needs to grow and sustain wealth.
4
Concierge lifestyle services
Our Family Office is designed to free your family’s time and resources by managing essential life events. Services include:
Bill pay: Collecting, paying, and tracking invoices.
Real estate: Acting as your proxy and managing logistics to ensure privacy.
Household employees: Managing payroll and employee administration.
Art advisory: Providing guidance on art collections.
Security: Protecting your family, home, and digital presence.
Private planes, boats, and cars: Overseeing maintenance for your assets.

Family Office Q+A with Andrew Cooper

## The Family Office Paradox

**Alone among many.** While the success of your family office confers tremendous opportunities, it also brings complexity. Families of means often juggle multiple professionals to manage their investments, taxes, estate planning, charitable giving, household logistics, and more. Still, no matter how many professionals they hire, the complexities of a family office can make them feel overwhelmed and unsupported.

If the family is supervising a patchwork of disparate professionals, the lack of specialized integration can lead to suboptimal planning and unnecessary stress. That is where the family office advisors at Cerity Partners can help.

## The Solution: Comprehensive Family Office Services

**Support beyond finances.** Cerity Partners Family Office provides a comprehensive suite of services that frees families to focus on what matters most. Our coordinated team of family office advisors is dedicated to preserving, growing, and protecting prosperity. We also serve as the family’s allies and advocates. Whether it’s creating an advanced giving strategy, preparing the next generation to be responsible stewards, optimizing the sale of a business, keeping family meetings productive, or simply saving them time, Cerity Partners’ family office advisors listen attentively and offer sophisticated solutions.

Cerity Partners Family Office can deliver the tools, infrastructure, and specialized knowledge that help the family manage life events and realize critical opportunities.

### The Family Office Experience: A Customized Approach

Families receive the full breadth and depth of Cerity Partners through highly personalized family office wealth management services from a dedicated team. The family office is customized in various ways, including a family charitable fund, a family LLC investment vehicle, and a family office email address that reaches the entire team and can be used to facilitate communication with other professionals.

Our firm's experienced family office advisors and technical specialists provide timely insights on the most opportunistic and challenging financial topics of the moment.

We attract and retain talented professionals in the wealth management industry. Advisors join Cerity Partners because they passionately believe in our approach.

#### Stewardship

We educate our clients on relevant wealth management issues and solutions, providing full transparency on all terms, risks, and expected outcomes.

Keeping the family’s financial house in order begins with bringing everything under one roof.

1

### Advanced holistic planning

A truly holistic wealth plan addresses every aspect of your family’s financial well-being and long-term vision. Our services include:

*   Legacy planning
*   Income tax strategies
*   Advanced estate planning
*   Trust and fiduciary oversight

We design and manage diversified, goal-centered portfolios tailored to your family’s objectives. With access to a broad range of assets and strategies, including exclusive opportunities, we help maximize potential returns.

We provide education, mentorship, and family governance guidance to equip future generations with the knowledge and tools they need to manage and sustain wealth responsibly.

Indie Asset Partners, LLC – Investing & Protecting Indianapolis
Indie Asset Partners offers investment advisory services for high net worth individuals, groups, and institutions. Each engagement begins with gaining a firm understanding of clients’ needs, goals, and risk tolerance. We then manage their assets to reflect those characteristics. We advise a number of clients whose main goals are wealth preservation and steady income, while others prefer the perceived risk of greater returns. Our primary philosophy is managing your money as if it were our own. 
At Indie Asset Partners, our investment disciplines and strategies are our own. We focus on reducing exposure to market volatility through diversification and the use of technical and macroeconomic analysis. We strive to anticipate and take advantage of market trends through use of a disciplined asset management approach. We find value across a variety of asset classes like common and preferred equities, bonds, currencies, commodities, and alternative funds, creating individualized, balanced portfolios that support the goals of our clients. 
Our team of investment advisors has a wide range of collective experience in managing portfolios through good and bad times, bull and bear markets, and periods of high volatility. This experience has led us to create proprietary research and methodology focused on regularly balancing a mix of assets based upon market conditions. In the end, our goal is to achieve positive returns at risk levels comfortable for each of our clients.

In the end, our goal is to achieve positive returns at risk levels comfortable for each of our clients.

Homedavid2025-11-26T14:21:16+00:00
“Our independent family office acts alongside you to manage your family’s wealth, achieving the optimal balance of preservation, enhancement and a sense of purpose for your wealth.”
Approach
Your Journey
As you journey through life, your focus on maximising, preserving, and enjoying your wealth will change. You reach the point where you want to spend less time managing your wealth preferring to spend time enjoying it. You may also be looking to achieve a greater sense of purpose from your wealth by creating a positive impact with it or by increasing your philanthropic giving. You may be considering gifting substantial amounts to others but nervous of the impact of doing so both for yourself and the recipients.
Our decades of experience of managing these changes and successfully navigating the challenges is why our clients value our personal approach.
Your Beliefs
Your upbringing and past experiences will have influenced your values and how you view life and plan your future. You have emotional and rational thoughts that will also affect your views. Instead of ignoring these factors, we listen and place your views at the centre of our advice to you, thus ensuring the foundations are built to create a long-term mutually beneficial relationship.
Our advice is implemented in the style and timeframe you feel comfortable with. Our ongoing proactive and dynamic service ensures a continuous assessment of the original plan whilst maintaining the ability to alter it if major changes occur in your family’s circumstances.
Your family
As families evolve over time there are often challenges and tensions in managing their wealth. Managing these is crucial to your family’s long-term happiness and fulfilment. We work with you to ensure that your family’s wealth has a positive influence by creating a greater sense of purpose from it.
We experience many family situations where the management of their wealth or the structures in which the assets are held are no longer fit for purpose. This often arises through an original lack of planning in managing the family’s wealth or where plans have not been reviewed as circumstances change.
We help to disentangle the ’knot’ of often complex issues surrounding family and wealth by providing advice on how to achieve long-term sustainable ownerships structures through a clear, actionable, and dynamic framework as a basis for your family’s continued prosperity and enjoyment.
Your investments
Having listened to how your journey has influenced your approach to life and family, we then agree with you how your assets are to be managed.
If you have strong views on which assets you want to hold or the investment style you want to adopt, then we will always incorporate these views into your overall portfolio management.
The size and complexity of our client’s wealth requires a tailored solution including many parts. We focus on orchestrating all the components, selecting, and collaborating with other firms to deliver the best outcome for you.
Only a firm that is truly focused on your needs will work with others to bring their skill sets to produce the overall best result for you.
Our Role
The multiplicity of firms offering their varying services in the wealth management sector is disconcerting for clients as they try to battle with industry jargon to identify the nuances between the range of services on offer and deciding which they need.
Having listened to these frustrations of successful clients, we created our business to solely focus on using our skill and experience to remove that problem by providing a complete overview of who and what is required for the overall successful management of your wealth. Our extensive knowledge of family wealth management and the participants enable us to recommend firms which are most appropriate for a particular service.
Whether you want us to manage all your wealth or you want to use multiple managers, do it yourself or a combination of all three, we believe that adopting a consolidated and co-ordinated approach produces a better outcome for you and your family.
We never hold assets on your behalf, preferring always that you hold them in your own name or with leading global custodians. This ensures that you have the comfort of segregating the advice from the security and safety of your assets.
Our investment philosophy
In a world where many try to complicate it, our investment philosophy is simple. There is no holy grail to investing nor is there one style of investing that will outperform every other year in year out.
We agree with you a suitable investment strategy based on our combined view of the future medium to long-term global trends. We then decide how to invest your wealth by investing into securities that we believe will benefit from these trends.
We diversify by selecting several long-term themes to follow rather than just one theme. We invest for the long-term avoiding an obsession about short term quarterly performances.
On implementing the investment portfolio, we can use the full range of securities available to optimise the balance of return and liquidity consistent with your aims.
We only invest in securities where we understand and are comfortable with the risks and transparency related to them.
Risk can mean different things to different people. We want to understand what risk means to you and having determined the risks that you are willing and able to take, we manage your wealth to your risk profile.

Investing is a long-term commitment to your financial well-being. It’s about growing and safeguarding your wealth. Our disciplined, goal-oriented approach ensures your portfolio remains resilient in the face of market and economic fluctuations.

Our sophisticated estate and wealth transfer strategies help you preserve your legacy while helping minimize tax burdens. Every recommendation is tailored to your specific needs, leveraging our extensive knowledge of estate, trust, gift, and tax regulations.

Successfully navigating the financial challenges that come with wealth necessitates planning, relevant advice, and a financial advisor who’s always in your corner. Cerity Partners provides all three.

Safeguard the financial security you and your loved ones have built. We assess your current risk exposure and develop customized strategies designed to protect the most vulnerable areas of your financial life.

Divorce marks the end of marriage but also the start of your new life. We can help you navigate the financial challenges of divorce and embrace the opportunities for building a thriving, secure future.

We work with owners of privately held businesses to help them create and execute transition plans that provide a seamless and successful exit for themselves, their families, and other stakeholders.

A partner in helping you determine strategic business decisions, streamline costs, and solve problems.

Our family office services free you to focus on what matters most, providing a coordinated team of specialists dedicated to preserving, growing, and protecting your family's prosperity.
Private Markets 
We aim to leverage our size, resources, and experience in private markets to source and conduct due diligence on highly curated and hard-to-access opportunities.
Beneficiary Financial Counseling 
When an employee dies, the greatest gift you can give their family is care and support. Our Beneficiary Counseling Services help beneficiaries navigate the financial challenges that arise after the death of a loved one, helping them adjust to their “new normal.”
Executive Financial Counseling 
Your compensation and benefits offerings are a talent retention necessity and, arguably, your executives’ largest source of wealth creation. Executive Financial Counseling helps your senior leaders fully realize these benefits and boost your ROI in the process.
Executive Financial Counseling for Individuals & Families 
The financial life of an executive is complicated, and coordinating all the elements takes time. We serve as your personal CFO, providing a more efficient and simpler way to manage your growing wealth.
Financial Wellness Coaching 
Your employees’ financial stress can have a cascading effect on absenteeism, morale, and productivity. Our comprehensive financial wellness coaching helps alleviate this stress, enabling employees to focus on their responsibilities at work.
Retirement Plan Consulting 
Secure retirements begin with a sound and effective plan. Our comprehensive approach is designed to address your goals and objectives while creating a competitive retirement plan for your employees.
Defined Benefit Plans 
Our retirement plan consultants understand the intricacies of managing active, frozen, and terminating defined benefit plans. They work closely with you to develop a course of action to mitigate risk, reduce costs, and drive better results.
Defined Contribution Services 
With increasing attention focused on fiduciary roles and responsibilities, maintaining a sound retirement plan is more important than ever before. We help you measure five critical dimensions of plan success to increase your plan’s effectiveness and the retirement readiness of your employees.
Nonqualified Plan Management 
We work with your board of directors, HR, and executive compensation teams to develop powerful nonqualified plan solutions that positively impact your recruitment, retention, and bottom line.
The Cerity Partners Pooled Employer Plan 
A retirement plan benefit, without the retirement plan hassle. Provide a retirement plan benefit for your employees, that also makes sense for your business.
Employee Stock Ownership Plans 
Implementing and growing successful ESOPs that drive employee engagement through an active ownership culture.
Corporate Venture Capital for Corporations 
We’ve combined the best of corporate and institutional venture capital to create a unique venture capital offering. Our team, with extensive venture capital industry expertise and corporate development skills, is dedicated to providing world-class strategy insights that help corporations adapt to the rapid pace of change.
Corporate Venture Capital for Entrepreneurs & Investors 
Startups endure constant pressure from well-funded competitors. Corporate venture investors can help differentiate your company by providing a brand halo, technical expertise, supply chain agreements, distribution or marketing assistance, and even good old-fashioned customer revenue.
